chronology: The original eight validation cases and five-percent threshold were committed before the campaign. The dilute-gas failure was then observed. The causal agent declared a paired n=2 block substitution and reverse intervention before measuring their effects. This file records that sequence after receiving those outcomes and before integrating the n=2 repair; it is not a retrospectively preregistered result.

observation.qualification: A transient source edit/revert occurred during this campaign. Retain its receipts unchanged and replay all cases at frozen final source before claiming validation.

hypothesis.statement: The surviving n=2 discrepancy comes mainly from the adopted 2s-2p collision closure: the legacy Huang/Seaton electron-plus-proton fit differs from the selected Cloudy PSM20 degenerate proton treatment.
interventions: At matched actual Cloudy electron density, substitute only the paired n=2 mixing block into the repaired finite-atom rate system.
Reverse the same intervention in the Cloudy system, with every other rate unchanged.
Repeat with charge conservation, explicitly labeling frozen diagnostic coefficient conventions.
hypothesis.discriminant: At least 80 percent of the original absolute n2 discrepancy is removed and the reverse substitution restores it. This applies the original dominance rule to the newly failing observable, without changing the five-percent acceptance threshold.

outcomes_known_when_recorded.qualification: Rounded causal-agent results. Exact retained diagnostic artifacts, not these rounded values, are the evidence to assess.

decision.selected: Use the same physically sourced PSM20 proton orbital-mixing closure for n=2 and n=3 in the finite coupled atom.
alternatives: Retain the legacy Huang/Seaton n=2 closure; valid as a distinct model choice but fails the registered comparison.
Fit or rescale n2 populations; rejected because it does not repair a physical rate model.
reasons: The isolated paired intervention and reverse distinguish the responsible process from bound-free or normalization changes.
PSM20 provides a declared rate equation and density-dependent cutoff, not a population correction.
A consistent explicit mixing closure in the finite atom is preferable to combining unrelated low-shell approximations for this controlled Cloudy comparison.
decision.source: Badnell et al. 2021, MNRAS 507, 2922, equations 6-12 and 22, https://doi.org/10.1093/mnras/stab2266
decision.scope: Finite nmax3/4/5 atom and registered conditions. The approximate near-degenerate low-n treatment is an adopted physical closure, not established exact low-n quantum collision physics.
decision.preservation: The historical six-state hydrogen_rates API retains its Huang/Seaton closure. The finite-atom no-orbital-mixing option preserves the previous comparison convention.
implementation_requirements: Remove the old paired n=2 mixing contribution before adding PSM20, to avoid double counting.
Apply inverse-process degeneracy and energy factors consistently.
Evaluate electron-density-dependent cutoffs inside the implicit charge root and derivative.
Keep the continuous combined lifetime/Debye integral rather than adopting the reference shortcut discontinuity.
required_verification: Independent cross-section integration and finite derivatives, including nested automatic differentiation.
Conservation, inverse-process consistency, implicit root derivatives and unchanged legacy six-state regressions.
Replay all eight registered cases at one frozen source identity; retain earlier failed campaign.

completion: The intervention supports choosing a repair; it does not establish final eight-case agreement or physical atmospheric adequacy.
